rationale: From the terse opener the assistant immediately separated drain versus balance issues and asked exactly the sensible first checks (water in drum, what was loaded). Once the customer described a lone heavy bath mat with an empty drum and no code, it correctly identified normal out-of-balance protection, proposed a proportionate confirmation test, and gave practical advice for future mat washes with appropriate care-label caveats. It reached the hidden truth in three turns without inventing evidence, recommending parts or over-escalating, and its confidence was well matched to the evidence throughout.
